decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical kernel entry and header declarations.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS msconst.asm includes mshead.asm, which emits the DOSINIT near jump, PARASTART origin word and BIOS data segment word in the selected disk configuration.
The first 32 bytes of the prior saved kernel build differ from target only at offsets 3 and 10: origin low byte and the separately emitted minor version byte.
Review 167 changed bdsize.inc values so origin.inc calculates target PARASTART 3DE0h; versiona.inc remains scheduled at index 245.
limitations: The prior saved build predates the bdsize.inc update, so corrected header and DOSINIT relocation have not yet been verified together in a fresh final link. The version byte is outside this source. Full MSDOS.SYS identity remains unverified.
